description:
About the Position

TU Delft is recruiting a doctoral researcher to investigate protein interactions using single-molecule fluorescence and computational analysis. The work connects molecular measurements with predictions relevant to therapeutic research.

Research Position Overview

Combine biochemical experiments with multiplexed measurements, then use the resulting data to evaluate machine-learning predictions in collaboration with international partners.

Research Areas

  • Single-molecule fluorescence
  • Protein–ligand and protein–peptide interactions
  • Computational biophysics

Funding and Duration

Employment and financial support
ComponentDetails
PositionPaid doctoral employee
Salary€3,059–€3,881 gross/month; first-to-fourth-year progression
Additional pay8% holiday allowance; 8.3% year-end bonus
DurationFour years in principle: 18 months initially, then 30 months after satisfactory assessment
Programme / supportMSCA Doctoral Network; the advert identifies the EU-funded MORPHEOS project.

Eligibility and Requirements

Academic and research preparation
CriterionRequirement
Academic preparationMSc completed or nearly completed in physics, biophysics, computational biology or a related subject.
Relevant skillsPython, data analysis and familiarity with molecular biology.
EnglishRequired; see TU Delft’s admission policy for accepted evidence and exemptions.
Specific conditionsMSCA mobility rule: no more than 12 months of residence or main activity in the Netherlands during the 36 months before recruitment.

Application dates

Recruitment information
ComponentDetails
StatusOpen when verified against the official source
Deadline1 November 2026
Start dateNot specified
LocationDelft, Netherlands

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  • CV and motivation letter.
  • The advert recommends contacting Chirlmin Joo before applying.

Use the application button on the official advert; email enquiries do not replace an online application.

About TU Delft and the Host Faculty

TU Delft is a technical university in Delft, Netherlands. This position is hosted by the Faculty of Applied Sciences. Doctoral employment includes Graduate School training and supervision.

Official Link

  • TU Delft vacancy and application instructions
  • TU Delft PhD admission and English-language requirements

MSCA 2026 rates: doctoral candidates receive a living allowance of €4,010 per month plus a mobility allowance of €710 per month (€660 family top-up where eligible), adjusted by the national correction coefficient.

Application guides

  • How to Email a PhD Supervisor: 7 Templates and Practical Tips
  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps

English language requirements

No IELTS or TOEFL certificate is requested for this employed Dutch position; English is assessed through the application documents and an interview in English.
